description: This header file declares internal API functions for an HTTP simple proxy object, including functions for managing interfaces, properties, state, operation, and various proxy-related activities. It also includes declarations for handling request and response headers and bodies, as well as socket-based communication for proxy operations.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetWamIf
methods.description: Gets the WAM (Web Access Manager) interface associated with the HTTP simple proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetWamIf
methods.description: Sets the WAM interface for the HTTP simple proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetSbcIf
methods.description: Gets the SBC (Server Browser Communication) interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetSbcIf
methods.description: Sets the SBC interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetCbcIf
methods.description: Gets the CBC (Connection Breaker Control) interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetCbcIf
methods.description: Sets the CBC interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetPbcIf
methods.description: Gets the PBC (Proxy Backend Connection) interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetPbcIf
methods.description: Sets the PBC interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetHfpIf
methods.description: Gets the HFP (HTTP Frontend Proxy) Interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetHfpIf
methods.description: Sets the HFP interface.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetProxyMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current proxy mode.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetProxyMode
methods.description: Sets the proxy mode.

methods.name: HttpSpoGetProperty
methods.description: Gets current properties of the proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties for the proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoResetProperty
methods.description: Resets the properties of the proxy object to default.

methods.name: HttpSpoReset
methods.description: Resets the proxy object to its initial state.

methods.name: HttpSpoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the HTTP proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the HTTP proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoWorkerInit
methods.description: Initializes worker components of the proxy.

methods.name: HttpSpoWorkerUnload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up worker components.

methods.name: HttpSpoAcquirePso
methods.description: Acquires a Protocol Service Object (PSO).

methods.name: HttpSpoReleasePso
methods.description: Releases a Protocol Service Object (PSO).

methods.name: HttpSpoManufacturePsoPool
methods.description: Creates a pool for PSOs.

methods.name: HttpSpoDestroyPsoPool
methods.description: Destroys the PSO pool.

methods.name: HttpSpoAcquireBmoReq
methods.description: Acquires a BMO (Backend Message Object) request.

methods.name: HttpSpoReleaseBmoReq
methods.description: Releases a BMO request.

methods.name: HttpSpoManufactureBmoReqPool
methods.description: Creates a pool of BMO requests.

methods.name: HttpSpoDestroyBmoReqPool
methods.description: Destroys the BMO request pool.

methods.name: HttpSpoAcquireBmoRep
methods.description: Acquires a BMO response.

methods.name: HttpSpoReleaseBmoRep
methods.description: Releases a BMO response.

methods.name: HttpSpoManufactureBmoRepPool
methods.description: Creates a pool for BMO responses.

methods.name: HttpSpoDestroyBmoRepPool
methods.description: Destroys the BMO response pool.

methods.name: HttpSpoWamAccept
methods.description: Accepts incoming WAM (Web Access Management) connection requests.

methods.name: HttpSpoWamConnect
methods.description: Establishes a WAM connection.

methods.name: HttpSpoWamClose
methods.description: Closes a WAM connection.

methods.name: HttpSpoSbcRequestHeaders
methods.description: Handles request headers for SBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoSbcRequestBody
methods.description: Handles request body for SBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoCbcReplyHeaders
methods.description: Handles reply headers for CBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoCbcReplyBody
methods.description: Handles reply body for CBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcRecvReqHeaders
methods.description: Receives request headers via PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcRecvReqBody
methods.description: Receives request body via PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcReqComplete
methods.description: Marks request processing as complete in PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcRecvRepHeaders
methods.description: Receives reply headers via PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcRecvRepBody
methods.description: Receives reply body via PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPbcRepComplete
methods.description: Marks reply processing as complete in PBC.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoAccept
methods.description: Accepts incoming private Web socket connections.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoSetOut
methods.description: Sets output state/output socket for private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoRemove
methods.description: Removes a private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoQuery
methods.description: Queries the private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoProcessSync
methods.description: Processes sync data on private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoProcessAsync
methods.description: Processes async data on private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoSendComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of sending on private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPrvwoNotify
methods.description: Notifies events on private Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoAccept
methods.description: Accepts incoming public Web socket connections.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoRemove
methods.description: Removes a public Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoQuery
methods.description: Queries the public Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoProcessSync
methods.description: Processes sync data on public Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoProcessAsync
methods.description: Processes async data on public Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoSendComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of send on public Web socket.

methods.name: HttpSpoPubwoNotify
methods.description: Notifies events on public Web socket.
